candidates.relationship: BRISC explicitly derives from Nickparvar's Brain Tumor MRI Dataset.
candidates.decision: Do not use as independent validation without provenance and patient-level separation evidence.

candidates.relationship: The BRISC paper identifies Cheng, SARTAJ and Br35H as upstream sources of Nickparvar.
candidates.decision: A different dataset title or file format does not establish independence.

candidates.scope: Diffuse glioma MRI and annotations; not four-class BRISC validation
gates: Review versioned files, download mechanism, disk space and checksums before acquisition
Group follow-up exams by actual patient identifiers
Review provided BraTS identity mapping; UCSF-PDGM and BraTS are not automatically independent
Document source independence relative to every training and development cohort
Build and verify NIfTI geometry, intensity and label adapters; current overlap CLI only handles 2D PNG/JPEG
Freeze patient cohort, task, preprocessing, metrics and selected checkpoint before scoring
No four-class accuracy or general brain-screening claims from a glioma-only cohort
